description: This file defines utility functions and classes for managing Kafka delegation tokens within Apache Spark, including token acquisition, configuration, and security setup.

classes.name: KafkaDelegationTokenIdentifier
classes.description: A class extending AbstractDelegationTokenIdentifier for Kafka delegation tokens.

methods.name: getTokenService
methods.description: Generates a Text object representing the token service for a given identifier.

methods.name: getClusterIdentifier
methods.description: Extracts the cluster identifier from a service Text.

methods.name: obtainToken
methods.description: Creates a Kafka delegation token and returns it along with its expiry timestamp.

methods.name: checkProxyUser
methods.description: Checks if the current user is a proxy user and throws an error if so.

methods.name: createAdminClientProperties
methods.description: Builds Kafka AdminClient properties based on SparkConf and cluster configuration.

methods.name: isGlobalJaasConfigurationProvided
methods.description: Checks if a global JAAS security configuration is available.

methods.name: setTrustStoreProperties
methods.description: Sets trust store related properties in Kafka client configuration.

methods.name: setKeyStoreProperties
methods.description: Sets key store related properties in Kafka client configuration.

methods.name: getKeytabJaasParams
methods.description: Constructs JAAS parameters string for Kerberos login using keytab.

methods.name: getTicketCacheJaasParams
methods.description: Constructs JAAS parameters string for Kerberos login using ticket cache.

methods.name: printToken
methods.description: Logs detailed information about a delegation token if debug logging is enabled.

methods.name: findMatchingTokenClusterConfig
methods.description: Finds a matching Kafka cluster configuration based on current user tokens and bootstrap servers.

methods.name: getTokenJaasParams
methods.description: Generates JAAS parameters for a token-based authentication.

methods.name: needTokenUpdate
methods.description: Determines if the current token needs to be refreshed based on configuration and parameters.
